description.text: Training Goal: to cultivate well-developed persons with comprehensive qualification and ability, who are needed in the modern world Learning Time: Enrollment is in September each year Teaching Method: The overseas students have classes with the Chinese students, and the diploma can be awarded after finishing the schemed course, gaining the needed credit hours and passing the thesis oral defense. The degree can be awarded after the permission of the school Degree Committee in accordance with " The Degree Statute of People’s Republic of China" Curriculum: The curriculum include Finance, Finance Management and Practice, Securities Investment and Management, Assets Assessment and Management, Investment and Financial Management

duration.text: The Finance at Hebei Finance University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Curriculum Vitae

requirements.text: 1.18-50 years old. 2. Be in good health Notice: Those who have obtained original HSK 3 certificate can directly apply for undergraduate study and the applicant should have the academic credentials analogous to those of Chinese senior middle school. Those who don't have hsk certificate can first study Chinese in the university, after passing the HSK, the applicant can become the degree students.
